title: Global function fields, reciprocity and automorphic foundations, Part II: root stacks and ramified geometric class field theory
summary: Starting from the parent’s adeles, ideles and arithmetic reciprocity, this extension constructs geometric rank-one character sheaves with square-root ramification along a divisor. Its reusable finite and infinite root stacks also supply DVR and anabelian consumers. The central outputs are an all-degree multiplicative root-Picard local system, its coherent Abel–Jacobi pullbacks, ramified norms and the quadratic Frobenius-trace comparison. Finite unity-root charts now have explicit cyclic group-algebra coordinates, retaining wild and zero-ring cases; the infinite diagonalizable identification remains open. The infinite unity-root Hopf coordinate comparison uses native rational-circle characters; its geometric quotient comparison remains partial. The actual arbitrary-section affine colimit carries the rational-character LEFT coaction η_f=(E_A⊗id)ρ_f, with native counit and coassociativity laws, root-power weights and coordinate reflection of universal coinvariance. The actual rational-character coaction now has an explicit heterobasic coefficient square for arbitrary φ:A→B, with identity/composition and one-way coinvariance preservation; this conditional algebra checkpoint retains all geometric boundaries. Native rational-coordinate proof evidence and three representative/level comparison APIs are recorded in the companion packet. The ten arbitrary-section rational LEFT coaction contracts now have separate admission-free exact-Mathlib proof evidence, and the ten coefficient contracts of PR5978 are replayed without their former admitted inputs. The defining-degree boundary and three additional tests are specified. Two inherited tensor-power precedence errors are corrected only in the Lean prototypes, leaving all mathematical contracts unchanged. Next complete full exact-pin Tau typing, positive-index/higher-universe transport, convolution-point identification, coherent root-object reindexing, affine Spec limits, fpqc frame torsors and quotient/DVR/Kummer comparisons. These algebraic certificates do not identify all coinvariants with A. Preserve all eight gaps, thirteen requests and both source routes.
readme: See the definitive roadmap document in research/blueprint/readmes/FunctionFieldArithmeticPartII.md. This Part II begins after the parent’s arithmetic reciprocity and imports ordinary Picard geometry and geometric stack infrastructure. Its general root-stack API retains full fibres, arbitrary exponents and inverse limits. The independent symplectic L-value route is assigned in the packet’s restructuring proposal.

stages.title: Root-object and affine-chart interfaces
stages.description: Native invertible-sheaf tensor and section powers, canonical trivial-power coordinates and the root equation with its unit coefficient; scalar equations for root arrows; isomorphisms of root data; root-specific universal Hopf coaction on A[T]/(Tⁿ−f), its counit/coassociativity, character weights and compatibility with the existing μ_n points. μ_n and monic quotient bases are baseline imports. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader. The finite action comparison has weighted monic/character coordinates, exact kernel and module cokernel, sharp injectivity and surjectivity criteria, a unit-parameter inverse and specified matrix determinant; normalized-coframe torsors are not arbitrary coarse root charts. Its elementary native proof branch has separate quotient-root relation, Euclidean power reduction, character-power and root-evaluation leaves.

stages.title: Finite root stacks
stages.description: The canonical root stack of a line bundle with section, including stack bases, Cartier divisors, affine quotient charts, base change, full fibres and relative coarse space; the invariant-ring calculation via the universal Hopf coaction, valid in arbitrary characteristic; the regular tame DM case. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader. Finite root data satisfy effective fpqc descent by the imported QCoh equivalence; algebraicity and coarse properties use their separate owners. On the finite affine chart, compare the actual diagonal character coordinates with the zero-character row. Universally invariant elements have only a constant coefficient; the native algebra-map equalizer is A through the coefficient map for every positive exponent, including wild and nonreduced bases.

stages.title: Infinite root stacks and DVR fibres
stages.description:
Divisibility transitions and coherent inverse limits; finite DVR reduced fibres and the infinite reduced gerbe, with neutralizations distinguished from canonical constructions. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader. Native finite-free affine transition maps and their iterated-quotient basis; infinite affine fpqc quotient; factorial reindexing; compatible Kummer-torsor/class comparisons. Infinite H1 is fpqc, finite Kummer is fppf; the all-roots-of2 example rejects a change to fppf infinite torsors. Identify each finite unity-root chart A[T]/(T^n−1) with A[Z/n], explicitly compare positive-divisibility transitions and the native coaction/counit/root-antipode; these finite formulas precede the still-required A[Q/Z] colimit and infinite quotient identification.

Specify the normalized characters c_n([k])=[k/n] and compatible finite chart maps. Their actual unity-root colimit equivalence with the native group algebra A[Q/Z] has separate injectivity, surjectivity, rational inverse-basis and comultiplication/counit/antipode/coefficient statements. Test orientation, scaled divisibility and wild nilpotents. This coordinate plan remains distinct from coherent groupoid, Spec-limit and fpqc quotient constructions; all stage coverage remains partial.

On C_A(f) for arbitrary f, use the inherited unity-root coordinate equivalence E_A:H_A≃A[Q/Z] to transport the LEFT coaction: η_f=(E_A⊗id_C)ρ_f into A[Q/Z]⊗_A C_A(f). State η_f(u_i)=e_[1/d_i]⊗u_i and η_f(u_i^k)=e_[k/d_i]⊗u_i^k, native counit/coassociativity, injectivity, universal coinvariance equivalence under tensor congr, and unity-chart agreement after transporting both tensor factors. Do not replace universal invariance by invariance under base-field points in wild characteristic. Coefficient-naturality and geometric fpqc descent require their own stated comparisons. The rational-character tensor coefficient map and coaction naturality square now have explicit declaration-sized contracts with unchanged character weights and one-way coinvariance preservation. The conditional proof prototype admits incoming coordinate/coaction dependencies; geometric transports and fpqc quotient work remain open. The 28 rational-coordinate declarations and three computation lemmas now have separate exact-Mathlib native proof evidence, including arbitrary coefficients and wild nilpotents. Next prove the admitted arbitrary-section rational coaction contracts over this actual equivalence, then replay the inherited conditional coefficient square without those admissions. Full canonical Tau typing, higher-universe/full-positive-index transport, coherent root-groupoid reindexing, affine Spec limits, fpqc frame torsors and the quotient/DVR/Kummer comparisons remain open. Preserve all eight gaps, thirteen requests and both source routes.

The ten arbitrary-section rational LEFT coaction contracts now have separate admission-free exact-Mathlib proof evidence, and the ten coefficient contracts of PR5978 are replayed without their former admitted inputs. The defining-degree boundary and three additional tests are specified. Two inherited tensor-power precedence errors are corrected only in the Lean prototypes, leaving all mathematical contracts unchanged. Next complete full exact-pin Tau typing, positive-index/higher-universe transport, convolution-point identification, coherent root-object reindexing, affine Spec limits, fpqc frame torsors and quotient/DVR/Kummer comparisons. These algebraic certificates do not identify all coinvariants with A. Preserve all eight gaps, thirteen requests and both source routes. On the actual factorial affine colimit C_A(f), universal LEFT coinvariants are precisely the coefficient image A for every commutative base and arbitrary section. Rational-character coefficient extraction detects each finite-level nonconstant coefficient without cancelling a root or assuming reducedness. The native algebra-map equalizer is A through the coefficient inclusion. This algebraic identification is distinct from coherent root-object reindexing, affine Spec limits, fpqc frame torsors and geometric quotient universality. The actual positive-divisibility colimit now has a rational-character LEFT coaction, compatible with every finite coaction, with native counit and coassociativity. Its universal coinvariants are exactly and uniquely the coefficient ring, realized by the native equalizer algebra equivalence; the factorial and positive-divisibility invariant coordinates agree. Still open: higher-universe target transports, coefficient-change naturality of these new positive-divisibility comparisons, coherent root-object groupoid reindexing, Spec-limit comparison, fpqc frame torsors and geometric quotient/descent, DVR and Kummer-limit routes. The reserved general root-stack key, all ten partial stages, all eight gaps, all thirteen supplier requests and every earlier source route remain open as recorded. Coefficient-ring maps between the actual positive-divisibility affine colimits and rational-character tensor products now satisfy root/constant formulas, identity and composition, commute with factorial cofinality and intertwine the universal coactions. The induced map of actual native coaction equalizers is natural in the unique invariant coefficient; its injectivity and surjectivity are exactly those of the coefficient-ring map. Arbitrary nonflat maps and zero rings are included, without reflecting ambient coinvariance. Still open: higher-universe target transport, coherent root-object groupoid reindexing, Spec-limit comparison, fpqc frame torsors and geometric quotient/descent, DVR and Kummer-limit routes. The general reserved root-stack key, all ten partial stages, eight gaps, thirteen supplier requests and prior paper routes remain as recorded.

stages.title: Root Picard stacks
stages.description: Graded line bundles with square roots along the reduced finite divisor R; square-action quotient, forgetful gerbe and the version carrying a root section. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: Root divisors and Abel–Jacobi maps
stages.description: Hat and nonzero-section spaces, evaluation pullbacks, smoothness, symmetric coarse spaces, tensor addition, ordered maps and both Abel–Jacobi maps. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: Adelic root Picard groupoids
stages.description: Modified local-unit fibre products and the idele double-quotient groupoid, with stabilizers and degree retained. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: Symmetric local systems
stages.description: Tame rank-one coefficients, collision descent, graded symmetric powers, exterior-power cohomology and associative multiplicativity. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: High-degree Abel–Jacobi descent
stages.description: Evaluation-surjective affine fibre charts, weighted-quotient simple connectivity and effective descent above the precise degree threshold. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: All-degree character sheaves
stages.description: Effective auxiliary divisors, canonical comparison and cocycles, all-degree extension, Abel–Jacobi pullback, unit, associativity and commutativity. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.

stages.title: Ramified norms and quadratic traces
stages.description: Root multiplicative sheaf, root norm, two-categorical exactness, quadratic specialization and Frobenius trace equal to the quadratic idele character. Exact declarations, hypotheses, API and acceptance tests are in the companion packet and reader.
